notes.content:
v1.2.0.0 ( June 25 - 2025 )


Engine update to Unreal Engine 5.6.0
Include missing movie file
Foliage world position offset animation optimizations to improve performance
World detail changes
Removing unused assets
Fixed cassette audio tape menu cancel button
Some sound changes

notes.title: v1.1.0.0
notes.content:
v1.1.0.0 ( June 12 - 2025 )


 Engine update to Unreal Engine 5.5.4
 Megalights support
 Performance improvements
 Less bright vegetation shading

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.8.0
notes.content:
Update to Unreal Engine 5.4.3
Increased performance due to new multi-core support
Less demanding global illumination ray-tracing model
Some voice changes

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.7.0
notes.content:
Motion blur setting added to effects menu
More spawn points
Some dialogue changes
Further color changes for particles
Some level design changes

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.6.0
notes.content:
Fixed alarm bug at the start of day 5
Key input added for turret and weapon
Disabled grenade key for now
Some level changes
Skipping the intro sequence will be disabled after 30 seconds gameplay

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.5.0
notes.content:
Removed the ultra graphics setting from the game which was present for the sake of completeness
Disabled Nanite for most of the geometry to improve performance
Removed some rocks in the path of the AI
Some voice fixes

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.4.0
notes.content:
Settings effects menu added to include multi color mode
Multi color mode available after completing the game
Cassette player mouse hover selection will now choose the correct diary audio file
Fixing clipping Nanite landscape in garage

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.3.0
notes.content:
Opening pause menu will close cassette player menu first
Cassette player menu will now additionally display mouse cursor and allows mouse selection of entries

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.2.1
notes.content: Changed landscape to Nanite mesh in order to fix disappearing ground on lower Global Illumination graphics settings

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.2.0
notes.content:
NVIDIA DLSS settings option will be removed if no NVIDIA GPU is present
AMD FSR setting added in settings display menu
Added Global Illumination graphics quality settings to improve performance
Added settings gameplay menu
Added mouse cursor sensitivity setting in settings gameplay menu
Fixed one issue with the phone

notes.title: They Came From Venus - Patch 1.0.1.0
notes.content:
NVIDIA DLSS added in settings display menu to improve performance, render quality, etc.
 Some ingame text fixes

notes.title: One Year in Early Access
notes.content:
After more than one hundred patches, several thousands of bug fixes, tweaks and adjustments it is time to conclude Dreadful Rivers first year of being in Early Access.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bBHbkOh01zM
 
Since the first release in February 28, 2023 a bunch of new content has found its way into the game:


way, WAY better performance
and still better graphics
the SEARCH FOR THE CROWNSTONES mainquest branch is fully implemented
a gateway town  where the river branches into the three biomes was introduced
there are now forts to conquer
and more factions
there’s wildlife, hunting and fishing
on land ruins, mines, caves, and ancient starling halls are waiting to be explored
skill trees, including special crown skills
more character classes for hire
siege engines
crew members can be positioned on the raft
nicer to use inventory system
more stuff to collect, use, craft and cook
loads of general QoL and bugfixes
Achievements


Now what’s next?


the underworld biome
more gear, spells, weapons
additional crafting plans and cooking recipes
new skilltrees
various new enemy types
new siege engine types
new factions
more dungeons
overall more river

For the future we are also experimenting with different game ideas in the background to follow up the development of Dreadful River. One of them is THEY CAME FROM VENUS, another one was in cryostasis for some years now and will be revealed in some weeks time.

Ending our update post with an obligatory busy-working-on-stuff picture.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/3357962/302faa2a0e5a2f16e281252215556596f560fed2.jpg

See you next time  :)
